# BookmarkItem

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Represents one bookmark and its optional child bookmarks in the document outline.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new BookmarkItem(title?: string, pageIndex?: number)
new BookmarkItem(options: BookmarkItemOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`children`](#children): Child bookmarks (nested outline items).
- [`pageIndex`](#pageindex): The 0-based page index this bookmark navigates to.
- [`title`](#title): The display title of the bookmark.
